cases.before: UPDATE heimdall_retention.capacity SET row_limit=used_rows+reserved_rows,byte_limit=(used_rows+reserved_rows)*8192; UPDATE heimdall_capacity.policy SET event_limit=used_events+reserved_events,byte_limit=used_bytes+reserved_bytes,delivery_limit=used_deliveries+reserved_deliveries; UPDATE heimdall_capacity.upgrade SET event_limit=(SELECT event_limit FROM heimdall_capacity.policy),byte_limit=(SELECT byte_limit FROM heimdall_capacity.policy),delivery_limit=(SELECT delivery_limit FROM heimdall_capacity.policy);CREATE FUNCTION heimdall_retention.fail_recovery_test() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF NEW.resolution='recovered' AND OLD.resolution='pending' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'injected' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$; CREATE TRIGGER fail_recovery_test BEFORE UPDATE ON heimdall_retention.decision_identities FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION heimdall_retention.fail_recovery_test()
